# FDG3060

> DO use a singular type name for an enumeration unless its values are bit fields.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.3 Naming Enumerations.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

```csharp
public enum ConsoleColor {
  Black,
  Blue,
  Cyan,
  ...
}
```
